column5: Lots 0 and 1a to 1d: PCs, Ethernet cable, internet box, DHCP, ping, desktop switches. Holds the beta fixes and the work shared by several lots.
Lots E and 2a to 2d: electricity, Wi-Fi, fixed cabling, peripherals and other home devices. Holds the beta fixes and the work shared by several lots.
Each PC gets its address through a real DHCP exchange with the box and shows it with the state of its lease.
From a PC, ping the other PC, which answers: terminal, ip addr, ARP, ICMP.
More PCs than the box has ports, all reachable by ping.
A device without power is off.
The laptop connects without a cable.
Cables run through wall sockets and trunking.
A shared file and a network printer.
Phone, camera and TV on the network.
